newsitem.title: UK: Swedish green rate to devalue Wednesday-HGCA.
newsitem.headline: Swedish green rate to devalue Wednesday-HGCA.

text.p: The Swedish crown's green rate will be devalued with efffect from Wednesday, the UK's Home Grown Cereals Authority said.
The green crown will devalue to 8.83274 per Ecu from the current rate of 8.71269, the HGCA said.
Also on Wednesday, the UK and Irish green rates will enter the final fifth confirmation period ahead of a possible revaluation on March 29, the HGCA said.

However, the HGCA pointed out that the Irish pound has fallen to the point where, if Tuesday's one-day rates are taken alone, it is already below the point at which a revaluation is triggered, which means it could avoid the revaluation.

Also sterling has fallen far enough to take its one day monetary gap to only just above the plus five per cent trigger point for a change. So further pound weakness could mean that it too avoids a March 29 change.
Green rates are used by the European Union to convert Ecus into the national currencies of its member states in its Common Agricultural Policy.
